---
description: "Review changed code for correctness, scope, production safety, and evidence."
argument-hint: "files, PR, or completed milestone"
agent: "code-reviewer"
tools:
  - read
  - search
  - edit
---
Apply `code-review` plus only relevant domain skills. Report concrete findings with evidence and smallest safe fixes.

When this review is the Final Review of a Plan, write `docs/.ai/Final-Review.md` and add a Final Review row to `docs/.ai/Plan.md` Execution Status (`prompt-driven-development` Final Review Authority). Change no other file.
